infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SpeakFiction records voice notes on this phone. Speech becomes text here, then only the text is sent to your desktop inbox.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SpeakFiction turns a take into text on this phone. Audio is not sent to a hosted transcriber.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SpeakFiction scans the QR code on your computer to link this phone. The camera is not used to send the book.
